description: Source code for managing netfilter nfacct counters via netlink in Linux, including functions for adding, retrieving, listing, and decoding netlink messages related to nfacct counters.

classes.name: runner
classes.description: Implements the Interface for managing nfacct counters via netlink, depends on a handler for executing netlink requests.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the nfacct interface, checking if the subsystem is supported.

methods.name: Ensure
methods.description: Ensures a counter with the given name exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new nfacct counter with the specified name.
